evidence: In the WebP alpha quantization path, returns 1 immediately when the 32-bit value at input+0x21c is zero. Otherwise, if input+0x5c50 is below 1, tail-calls compute_webp_alpha_quantization_levels. For an enabled state, dispatches a virtual method on the subobject at input+0x230 and, when that result is nonzero, dispatches its second method slot at vtable+0x18; then returns 1. Caller compute_webp_alpha_quantization_levels tail-calls this routine after setting up the alpha path (decompiled/main/main_0128.c:22208-22211); encode_webp_image calls it on its encoder object (38171-38175). Target body: decompiled/main/main_0128.c:22221-22246.

Initializes the caller output to UINT32_MAX. If the setup helper succeeds, resolves the attribute provider using a signed 16-bit selector/index read from the helper result at +0x130; when the provider pointer at +0x30 is null, invokes the fallback helper. It then reads nested property selector 0x13 through nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts the returned float to signed int, and stores that value to the output. If setup fails, output remains UINT32_MAX. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:33290-33315. No indexed caller is available.

When the enable argument x2 is zero, or the pointer at x3 is null, queries attribute-context status selector 1 and passes the resulting status with flag 1 to f_70007ad80c. Otherwise it compares the pointed-to text against a static string using f_7001c1fb60; equality selects status selector 2 with flag 0, and inequality selects selector 1 with flag 1. The returned status is passed with that flag to f_70007ad80c; this routine returns zero. The downstream helper semantics are unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0085.c:5390-5411. No indexed caller is available.

If the global pointer at 0x7003abf000+0xa98 is null or its 32-bit field at +0x18c is not 1, obtains a context through f_70008dc780 and returns 2 when its 32-bit field at +0xc0 equals 3. Otherwise, or if that field differs, queries status selector 0x13 and returns 2 when its low byte equals 8; all remaining paths return zero. decompiled/main/main_0076.c:17684-17708. No indexed caller is available.

Initializes the output to UINT32_MAX, calls the first helper with the output pointer, then evaluates attribute-context status selector conditions. It selects the first helper result when the predicate low bit is clear, otherwise selects 1; the selected low byte maps 0 to output 2, 1 to output 0, and any other nonzero value to output 1. The first helper result domain is unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:25006-25023; predicate helper decompiled/main/main_0006.c:33781-33832.
